tasks.label: python: venv check
args: if (-not (Test-Path '.venv')) { Write-Host 'Virtual environment not found. Creating...'; python -m venv .venv }; Write-Host 'Virtual environment ready.'

tasks.label: docker: build and run
args: docker build -t hitl-email-assistant:latest . ; docker run -d --name hitl-email-assistant -p 8000:8000 -e AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT='https://placeholder.openai.azure.com/' -e AZURE_OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL='gpt-4o' -e AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION='2024-12-01-preview' -e AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY='placeholder-key' hitl-email-assistant:latest

tasks.label: terraform: init and validate
args: cd infra; terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl.example; terraform fmt -check; terraform validate
